DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_LegendDeer:
Can be ridden.
While mounted, it generates a barrier that blocks all attacks. Can triple jump while mounted.
Increases own Grass damage by 20%, grants a life steal effect that restores 10% of damage dealt as Health, and reduces own active skill cooldowns by 20%.

<Status_Keyword>Impervious</>: Cannot be <Status_Keyword>flinched</>, <Status_Keyword>knocked back</> or <Status_Keyword>stunned</>.
